text:
Maya Patel: heads-up from field: MediSpark wants eval-triggered alerts + an "Optimize Advisor" that suggests batching, KV cache TTLs, and quant profiles. They want a 6-week trial and clear rollback controls.
Samir Khan: ok scope check. two deliverables: (A) eval-alerting pipeline + webhook + ops runbook, (B) advisor engine + small UI + sims. Can we pare down MVP?
Jen Lee: MVP idea: alerts = single-metric delta + webhook + per-tenant mute. Advisor = offline sims that output 3 ranked recs; no auto-apply. That reduces UX surface.
Ravi Kumar: tech constraints: need per-prompt eval hooks and sampling to avoid volume spikes. For advisor sims we need reproducible quant runs on a small GPU pool. Also recommend confidence scoring for each rec.
Alex Gomez: MediSpark cares about auditability and low FP. They'll only accept pilot if FP < 4% and recommendations include evidence (sample prompts, before/after diffs).
Nina Park: legal/security: need CSV export and retention policy. Also RBAC so only tenant admins can toggle recommendations.
Maya Patel: proposed gates: 1) Alerts: validated on 3k prompts with FP <= 4%, webhook with backoff, per-tenant mute, ops playbook. 2) Advisor: produces 3 recs (batch size, kv-ttl, quant) with confidence >= 0.6 and simulated >=8% cost win on at least 2 sample workloads.
Samir Khan: rough ETA: alerts MVP 5 weeks (infra + QA + runbook). advisor offline sims + output 4-6 weeks after alerts. Shared: telemetry and feature-flagging will be common work.
Jen Lee: UX notes: alert payload must state "why" in one sentence, show metric delta, include up to 3 sample prompts, and provide one recommended next step with exact numbers.
Ravi Kumar: heuristic sketch:
```
# TTL heuristic (pseudo)
if duplicate_rate >= 0.25 and p99_latency < 200:
  recommend_ttl = min(600, observed_dup_window)
else:
  recommend_ttl = 0  # suggest disabling cache
# quant gating
run_n_shot_eval(100)
if quality_drop_pct < 0.7 and latency_reduction_pct > 12:
  recommend_quant = "int8"
else:
  recommend_quant = "none"```
Alex Gomez: field will provide a 2k labeled set and two SME hours. They want a canary toggle to 5% tenants and immediate rollback.
Maya Patel: action items: Samir draft acceptance criteria doc by Tue EOD; Jen prototype alert payload + mock UI by Thu; Ravi produce heuristics note + minimal sim plan by Mon. I'll request 2 GPUs for sims and raise support headcount for pilot support.
Samir Khan: include CSV export test and RBAC check in acceptance criteria. Also include alert latency SLA: emit <2.5s after eval hook.
Jen Lee: add copy templates for customers and a short FAQ about quality/rollback.
Ravi Kumar: ops note: include an "alert-suppress" flag and alert-churn metric to watch during pilot. If churn > X alerts/day consider pausing.
Maya Patel: scheduling: kickoff with MediSpark next week. We'll gate advisor work on alerts sign-off. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
